As Tiffany & Company (TIF) Market Valuation Declined, Horan Capital Management Cut Stake by $1.15 Million; Patterson Cos (PDCO) Holder Barrow Hanley Mewhinney & Strauss Raised Its Stake by $10.96 Million as Market Value Declined
May 15, 2018 - By Winifred Garcia
Horan Capital Management decreased its stake in Tiffany & Company (TIF) by 80.73% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Horan Capital Management sold 11,178 shares as the company’s stock declined 6.13% with the market. The institutional investor held 2,669 shares of the consumer specialties company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $277,000, down from 13,847 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Horan Capital Management who had been investing in Tiffany & Company for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $12.68B market cap company. The stock decreased 1.12% or $1.15 during the last trading session, reaching $101.84. About 843,548 shares traded. Tiffany & Co. (NYSE:TIF) has risen 1.55% since May 15, 2017 and is uptrending. It has underperformed by 10.00% the S&P500.
Barrow Hanley Mewhinney & Strauss Llc increased its stake in Patterson Cos Inc (PDCO) by 6.24% based on its latest 2017Q4 regulatory filing with the SEC. Barrow Hanley Mewhinney & Strauss Llc bought 304,402 shares as the company’s stock declined 40.18% with the market. The institutional investor held 5.18 million shares of the health care company at the end of 2017Q4, valued at $187.26M, up from 4.88M at the end of the previous reported quarter. Barrow Hanley Mewhinney & Strauss Llc who had been investing in Patterson Cos Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $2.08B market cap company. The stock decreased 0.22% or $0.05 during the last trading session, reaching $22.5. About 539,981 shares traded. Patterson Companies, Inc. (NASDAQ:PDCO) has declined 51.49% since May 15, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 63.04% the S&P500.

The rating was maintained by Cowen & Co with “Market Perform” on Wednesday, May 18. The rating was maintained by Jefferies on Wednesday, April 5 with “Buy”. The firm has “Hold” rating by Wells Fargo given on Wednesday, January 17. The firm has “Buy” rating given on Thursday, July 13 by Oppenheimer. Cowen & Co maintained the shares of TIF in report on Friday, August 26 with “Market Perform” rating. The firm earned “Buy” rating on Wednesday, July 29 by Mizuho. The company was initiated on Thursday, September 29 by CLSA. Deutsche Bank maintained Tiffany & Co. (NYSE:TIF) rating on Friday, August 26. Deutsche Bank has “Hold” rating and $75.50 target. The firm earned “Sector Perform” rating on Thursday, September 10 by RBC Capital Markets.
Analysts await Tiffany & Co. (NYSE:TIF) to report earnings on May, 23 before the open. They expect $0.84 EPS, up 13.51% or $0.10 from last year’s $0.74 per share. TIF’s profit will be $104.58M for 30.31 P/E if the $0.84 EPS becomes a reality. After $1.67 actual EPS reported by Tiffany & Co. for the previous quarter, Wall Street now forecasts -49.70% negative EPS growth.
